Opening something for Hazel…

For Hazel, Someone Beautifully Difficult to Describe.

Someone took the thoughts he could never quite say out loud and, slowly, turned them into something written — just for you.

It asks nothing of you. It is only a quiet place where the things he noticed could finally find their words.

Take it at your own pace, and feel whatever you feel.

Some things are easier to write than to say.
